name: zetetic-genius
description: Grades every request before its turn starts (task class → effort rung, in one low-effort completion) and routes it to the genius reasoning patterns and problem-shaped skills whose trigger it matches, from the installed zetetic-team-subagents index; under enforce, the matched pattern's workflow rides beside the prompt.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe: the grade and the picks are logged and shown above the prompt, nothing is attached. enforce: the matched patterns' workflow is attached to the prompt as context.

classifier_model.title: Classifier model
classifier_model.description: The model that grades each request in one low-effort completion. An alias (haiku, sonnet) or a full id; Haiku 5.5 is built for classification and routing.
